questions.question: How does Jeremiah 17 describe the human heart?
options: Deceitful above all things, and desperately sick
Easily taught, quick to follow the truth
Strong and steadfast, firm against all temptation
Pure and upright, made in the image of God
questions.answer: Deceitful above all things, and desperately sick

questions.question: To what is the one who trusts in the LORD compared in Jeremiah 17?
options: Chaff that the wind drives away from the threshing floor
A lonely shrub in the parched and salty desert
A reed bending and breaking in the rushing wind
A tree planted by water that does not fear when heat comes
questions.answer: A tree planted by water that does not fear when heat comes

questions.question: Jeremiah 17 calls the people to keep the Sabbath holy and not bear burdens on it.
